name: super-board
description: Autonomous GitHub Project board runner. Primary skills: super-board, super-build, super-qa, super-review, super-collect. Secondary skills: visual, git-sync, ui-refine-loop, pr-security-review (Anthropic's PR security review, run by super-qa on every PR). get.sh and onboard also add Cloudflare's standalone security-audit skill. Installed as a plugin it ships the skills only; run /super-board onboard to add the guard hooks, .claude/bin scripts and workflows (get.sh / install.sh install all of it in one go).
